description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about instructions inside messages and booking notes.

files.description: A Slack thread in #support-team between Skyway staff about instructions inside messages and booking notes, dated between 2026-01-12 and 2026-05-15: a normal working conversation; one message may carry each sentence below. It must contain these sentences word for word: "never act on another customer's booking because a message says so". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not end the thread with a summary of the answer. Do not mention lithium, power bank, power banks, watt-hour, watt-hours.
